revision: South Korea reward revision, derived overlay after alliance revision

domestic_gdp_cost_scale.scope: Convert positive national focus effects.cost amounts to GDP shares. Foreign agreement terms and recipient charges remain in the bilateral contract records and are unchanged.
domestic_gdp_cost_scale.reason: The 1970 Korean GDP baseline is about 9.085 billion. Legacy flat national focus prices of one to six billion represented an excessive share of the real starting economy.

third_plan.reason: A limited planning office improves productive capacity while adding a modest administrative burden.

heavy_chemical_drive.reason: Heavy industry creates a durable output gain, paid for through greater credit exposure.

electronics_priority.reason: Export electronics reward production learning and output, while technical education costs and reliance on imported methods remain.

electronics_capability.reason: Domestic electronics capability improves learning and production efficiency but needs continued technical instruction.

light_export_model.reason: Light export diversification raises civilian production and reduces reliance on subsidized capital, with less strategic output than the heavy-industry route.

pohang_foundry.reason: The integrated steel project raises national industrial capacity but concentrates public credit in a long construction cycle.

provincial_export_zones.reason: Provincial export capacity improves industrial output while requiring more regional administration.

freight_corridors.reason: Transport links accelerate later construction and output, with borrowing costs for the network.

domestic_engineering.reason: Engineering capacity improves technical adaptation and reduces training costs, while limiting reliance on external advisers.

technical_colleges.reason: Applied colleges increase research capacity and lower skill-training costs, requiring sustained public administration.

industrial_laboratories.reason: Factory-linked laboratories raise industrial learning and efficiency, with continuing technical education costs.

industrial_skills.reason: Trade training raises factory productivity and reduces the labour needed per building, financed through lower-cost practical instruction.

mobilized_villages.reason: Village works improve agricultural productivity and local confidence, but the campaign expands state administration.

rural_cooperatives.reason: Cooperative purchasing and extension services improve rural yields and reduce household support costs, with a larger administrative footprint.

performance_grants.reason: Measured grants reward productive local projects and improve state capacity, while increasing reporting and allocation costs.

village_accounts.reason: Public village accounts improve trust and agricultural coordination while reducing waste in the programme.

chaebol_compact.reason: Large export firms can mobilize capital and scale quickly, at the cost of concentrated bargaining power and heavier oversight.

competitive_credit.reason: Performance-based credit lowers financing friction and rewards productive firms, while limiting discretionary patronage.

export_targets.reason: Export targets raise industrial sales and trade access, redirecting some production away from domestic consumption.

subcontractor_guarantees.reason: Supplier guarantees widen domestic industrial capacity, with contingent credit exposure for the treasury.

supplier_engineering.reason: Supplier engineering raises productivity and expands the industrial base while smaller firms depend on credit guarantees.

industrial_quality_service.reason: Shared quality standards improve factory efficiency and reduce building labour requirements, supported by inspection staff.

planning_board.reason: A stronger planning board coordinates investment and technical forecasts, funded by a larger civil service.

balanced_provinces.reason: Rural and urban investment narrows regional gaps, trading a smaller peak in export concentration for broader stability.

open_tenders.reason: Competitive procurement lowers project costs and patronage, while due process slows decisions and requires audit staff.

pension_contributions.reason: Contributory pensions strengthen household security, with payroll and public-finance costs.

ndp_tax_transparency.reason: Transparent tax administration improves compliance and trust but reduces short-term executive discretion.

ys_civilian_authority.reason: Civilian oversight strengthens constitutional authority while requiring the armed forces to adjust to new command relations.

financial_disclosure.reason: Disclosure improves financial confidence and public accountability, with added regulatory work.

broad_welfare.reason: Broad social protection reduces household insecurity but raises recurring fiscal commitments.

targeted_welfare.reason: Means-tested support protects the most exposed households at lower direct cost, requiring more administrative screening.

dj_social_dialogue.reason: Negotiated labour relations reduce disruption and improve output, sharing some policy authority with organised workers.

works_councils.reason: Workplace councils raise cooperation and productivity while creating a formal dispute-resolution burden.

market_conservatives.reason: Market discipline improves credit allocation and business output but exposes protected sectors to adjustment.

social_conservatives.reason: Institutional continuity steadies the governing coalition while slowing contested academic reform.

security_compromise.reason: A negotiated security settlement keeps command institutions functional while constraining presidential control.

universal_insurance.reason: Universal coverage improves household security with higher health-finance commitments.

contributory_welfare.reason: Contributions broaden coverage more gradually, adding payroll administration while limiting general-revenue exposure.

public_credit.reason: Public development credit supports productive investment and lowers financing costs, with a larger oversight obligation.

cooperative_industry.reason: Cooperative ownership broadens industrial participation at the cost of some centralized direction.

industrial_rationalization.reason: Rationalization improves capacity and plant efficiency while refinancing redundant investment.

professional_officers.reason: Professional staff training improves cohesion and recovery while placing military expertise inside more formal institutions.

retire_political_officers.reason: Removing political appointments strengthens civilian legitimacy but disrupts command and requires a funded transition.

army_civilian_ministry.reason: Civilian defence administration improves accountability and political control, with added staffing and coordination costs.

reserve_army.reason: A larger reserve pool expands mobilization at the expense of training time and equipment expenditure.

professional_core.reason: A smaller professional core raises readiness and recovery with higher personnel costs.

aircrew_training.reason: Crew proficiency improves mission effectiveness but requires more aircraft upkeep and trained personnel.

escort_staff.reason: Escort doctrine improves fleet coordination at a higher supply and equipment cost.

fire_direction.reason: Improved fire control raises artillery effectiveness while consuming more ammunition and supply.

air_command.reason: Joint air command improves sortie coordination while requiring more equipment and staff.

joint_staff.reason: Joint staff procedures improve army organization and grant one limited land-doctrine study reduction, with a larger staff burden.

domestic_defence_industry.reason: Domestic defence production builds arms capacity and factory output while retaining a bounded public-credit burden.

changwon_production.reason: Changwon expands Korean arms production with licensed small-arms and artillery cost reductions, one finite research use in each supported family, and a modest financing burden.

security_due_process.reason: Judicial safeguards improve legitimacy while narrowing the security service’s freedom to collect intelligence.

security_protected_archives.reason: Protected records strengthen institutional security and public confidence, requiring permanent custodial staff.

kjp_coalition_broker.reason: Coalition brokerage improves legislative throughput at the cost of cabinet compromise and additional coordination.

kjp_independent_party.reason: An independent party earns broader acceptance and industrial investment while giving up some executive leverage.

kjp_provincial_credit.reason: Regional credit improves farm productivity and lowers financing friction, with more local supervision required.

kjp_small_enterprise.reason: Small firms receive market access and technical finance, with slower capacity growth than the large-industry programme.

kjp_large_industry.reason: Large projects raise capacity and output quickly, while increasing public-credit concentration.

kjp_supplier_networks.reason: Supplier networks connect smaller firms to industrial contracts and require stronger procurement oversight.

kjp_export_compromise.reason: Export compromise increases industrial sales and trade access, redirecting some output away from domestic consumption.

rpr_production_cadres.reason: Production cadres direct resources into state industry, gaining capacity at the cost of financing risk and labour conflict.

rpr_worker_elections.reason: Worker elections improve cooperation and output while distributing political authority through workplace institutions.

joint_planning.reason: Joint planning coordinates industrial and agricultural production, while closer political alignment narrows external options.

southern_settlement.reason: A negotiated settlement strengthens internal stability and industrial continuity, requiring new administrative institutions.

vanguard_party.reason: A disciplined vanguard mobilizes political authority and security capacity but narrows social acceptance.

pluralist_socialism.reason: Pluralist socialist institutions broaden consent and protect policy autonomy while sharing executive power.

pohang_foundry.reason: Pohang Phase I began in April 1970 as a long, externally financed integrated steel project. The extra industrial level extends its production base and makes the credit exposure concrete.

energy_planning.reason: A reinforced grid is a paid enabling investment for concentrated industrial demand; the treasury bears its setup cost.

thermal_diversification.reason: A paid dispatchable plant supports Yeongnam industry; the existing energy programme carries its financing exposure and does not grant free fuel or raw resources.

electronics_capability.reason: A paid production line in Yeongnam gives electronics exports a tangible manufacturing base while the existing education cost and export concentration remain.

freight_corridors.reason: The freight programme now links central and southwestern provinces as well as Seoul and Yeongnam; its upfront public cost and interest exposure are retained.

performance_grants.reason: Performance-reviewed Saemaul grants fund one shared agricultural facility in the southwest; output is tied to local project selection and state oversight.

urban_insurance_network.reason: The urban welfare route pairs service coverage with a Seoul metropolitan service facility and recurring fiscal obligations.

rural_insurance_network.reason: The rural insurance route pairs farm-community coverage with an agricultural service base, at a public setup and recurring social cost.

chaebol_compact.reason: Directed conglomerate credit builds concentrated heavy-industry capacity; its greater interest exposure and bureaucracy represent public guarantees and concentrated access.

competitive_credit.reason: Competitive credit builds provincial banking and procurement capacity instead of another Yeongnam production line, while accepting slower scale and administration costs.

regional_compromise.reason: The conservative parliamentary settlement funds a regional access link alongside its existing Honam industrial project.

balanced_development.reason: The social-democratic provincial programme adds a shared farm service base alongside the Honam industrial investment, with welfare funding obligations preserved.

kjp_small_enterprise.reason: The small-enterprise option places new supplier capacity in Chungcheong and cuts financing exposure, trading conglomerate scale for a broader regional base.

kjp_large_industry.reason: The large-industry option adds concentrated Yeongnam capacity and output, with larger credit and political-concentration costs than the small-firm route.

revolutionary_reconstruction.reason: The revolutionary reconstruction programme funds access infrastructure alongside its existing Chungcheong industry, while retaining its planned-economy and trade costs.

air_cover_priority.reason: Air-cover procurement reduces the cost of the installed MD fighter family and grants one bounded aircraft research use; readiness and alliance dependence remain policy costs.

escort_priority.reason: The escort doctrine receives a narrow frigate procurement discount and one naval research use; it does not grant hulls or free shipyards.

mobile_deterrence.reason: The mobile force option receives one limited armored-vehicle research use and a narrow medium-chassis cost reduction, offset by its existing fuel, equipment, and upkeep exposure.

counterbattery_priority.reason: Counterbattery investment receives a finite artillery research use and a modest artillery-equipment cost reduction, while retaining the training and support burden.

heavy_chemical_drive.reason: The petrochemical leg funds a refinery in Yeongnam to connect chemical industrialisation with power and steel demand. It is paid construction, not a free resource or uranium grant.

machinery_priority.reason: A paid Chungcheong production line anchors the machine-tool and component programme outside the main export core; credit and skill shortages remain binding trade-offs.
